selection: Every registered pair, both natural source worlds, preservation/current_A and current_C in the C-axis stratum. No mixed caches, oracles, error-only filtering, retraining or hyperparameter selection. Deduplicate exact natural-prefix/question identities, then reuse each physical observation for every registered binding.

native_references: Reuse each natural source full-prefill reference frozen in the event registry; use the newly audited full_C_baseline rows for current_C. Compare own-source-world truths only. Do not relabel left-world current answers as right-world failures.
prefix_checks: For question-only adaptation, on minimum/maximum pair identities in every cohort/stratum, verify exact complete KV/recurrent/convolution cache bookkeeping and final-ledger logits under separate ledger-only native versus enabled-adapter prefills, before any question token. Record and deduplicate repeated prefix identities. Do not claim prefix identity for all-token adaptation.
runtime_safety: Use the same existing base environment/text-only model and group3 GDN-only implementation. Verify fixed final checkpoint tensors and696192 adapter parameters, freeze all evaluation weights, no gradients/optimizer updates, unchanged native and adapter state hashes, actual full-history access at all six Attention layers, hook restoration and sampled detached native readout replay. Independent operational smoke precedes the complete transfer cohort; smoke performance is not a gate.
smoke: First lexicographic case/value identity in each of the six cohort/stratum groups, both worlds/all registered questions and both fixed adapters. Deduplicate only exact natural prefix/question identities; all six operational groups remain represented.
reporting: Both cohorts, all strata and all value/base-stream cases. Report per-role and joint preservation/current-update outcomes, paired changes versus native and between timing checkpoints, natural A/C update competence and every regression. Count unique queries and related reported bindings separately. Do not pool the four-base-stream cohorts into independent-readout confidence claims.
interpretation: This is frozen-checkpoint transfer from the earlier eight-account, at-most832-token semantic training tasks, not matched training on the new2865-token distribution.
